GOOGLE DEVELOPER STUDENTS CLUBS (GDSC)

GDSC is a community initiated to help students of various learning instutions grow their skills in the tech field. mostly developers. Some of these fields include Web Development, Machine Learning and Software Development, of which most are related to android platforms.

GDSC has been established in several universities across the globe. In Ghana alone, over twenty universities have GDSC established, and AIT is privileged to be amongst these universities.
